Question: A boat has a speed of \(x\) kilometers per hour in still water, and the current has a speed of 3 kilometers per hour. Traveling 48 kilometers downstream takes the same amount of time as traveling 36 kilometers upstream. Find \(x\).
Solution: Set up the equation \(\frac{48}{x+3}=\frac{36}{x-3}\). Clearing the denominators gives \(48(x-3)=36(x+3)\), so \(x=21\). Checking confirms that it fits the practical situation.
